answer.reason: The verses tell of Hoham joining the five kings against Gibeon and being brought out to Joshua, which goes beyond the summary.

clauses.english: went up with four other Amorite kings and made war against Gibeon
clauses.quote: gathered themselves together, and went up

clauses.english: was brought out of the cave to Joshua with the four other kings
clauses.quote: brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave

doubts: JOS 12:10 only lists him among the defeated kings, so it was not used.
The verses on the cave and his fate (JOS 10:16-22, 26) were not fully given, so nothing is said of how he came to be in the cave or what became of him.
